kycEvidence.trigger: After successfully completing the challenge and before FundedNext Account activation
additionalChecks: A driver's licence is accepted only for the countries listed by FundedNext.
A utility bill or bank statement issued within the previous 3 months may be requested for address verification.
timing: The published typical verification time is about 48 hours.
postKyc: Successful verification makes the trader eligible to receive the FundedNext Account.
Failure to pass KYC results in rejection of the FundedNext Account application.

kycEvidence.trigger: After passing the final evaluation stage and before the funded-account contract
documents: Proof of identity, such as a government-issued ID
additionalChecks: Accepted documents vary by the trader's country of residence.
After KYC approval, the Bright Funded Risk Team performs a Security Check.
timing: The Security Check normally takes 1–2 business days from Monday to Friday.
Bright Funded publishes a peak-period maximum of 4 business days.
postKyc: The trader contract is sent automatically after the Security Check is approved.
The funded account is activated after the contract is signed.

kycEvidence.trigger: Before full access to the Master Account
kycEvidence.provider: FundingPips, with separate provider verification for some reward methods
documents: Government-issued ID, driver's licence, permanent residence permit or passport
additionalChecks: FundingPips permits only one verified identity and one account per trader.
Rise onboarding requires the same email used with FundingPips, a government-issued ID and a selfie.
timing: The KYC step usually takes a few minutes.
In Review and Onboarding can each take up to 2 working days.
postKyc: The published 4-step sequence is KYC, In Review, Customer Agreement and Onboarding.
Trading on the Master Account starts only after all required setup steps are complete.

requestSteps: Complete the applicable trading cycle and profitability criteria.
Submit the Payout Request in the account dashboard.
Confirm the request with an OTP sent to the registered email.
processing: FundedNext publishes payout issuance within 24 hours after a valid request.
Stellar 1-Step rewards are scheduled every 5 business days.
Stellar 2-Step and Stellar Lite start after 21 days and then use 14-day cycles.
Stellar Instant on-demand eligibility requires its separate growth and EOD gate.
fees: The trader is responsible for transfer gateway charges.
countryBoundary: Bank Transfer is not available as a Performance Reward method for the countries listed by FundedNext, including Russia.
A listed crypto method does not resolve the separate conflict in FundedNext's official Russian-resident access statements.

requestSteps: Close all open trades and pending orders.
Wait until the published pay day or later.
Submit the request from the Payout Section of the Bright Funded dashboard.
processing: The first standard Reward Split is available 30 days after the first funded-account trade.
After the first Reward Split, the standard cycle is 14 days.
Bright Funded publishes a maximum of 1 day for finance-team processing after the request.
fees: Bright Funded says it does not charge an additional payout fee.
Third-party network, bank, provider and currency-conversion fees can still apply; the help article says some cases range from USD 5 to USD 50 and may rarely exceed that range.
countryBoundary: USDC ERC-20 availability does not waive SumSub KYC, the Risk Team Security Check or country eligibility.
The receiving bank, wallet and payment provider must support the selected route for the trader's actual profile.

requestSteps: Close all trades and pending orders before submitting a reward request.
Wait at least 15 minutes after closing positions.
Use a card, wallet or bank account in the verified trader's own name.
processing: FundingPips publishes internal processing of 1 to 3 working days.
The receiving wallet or bank may need an additional 1 to 2 working days.
Product-level first-reward gates range from 7 to 14 days where a current number is published.
fees: Network, bank or provider costs depend on the selected reward method and must be checked before the request.
